findings.text: the evidence figure is written outside the node's four-path fence and appears in the diff as a fifth changed path; it is disclosed in the manifest and required by the graphics mandate, but the fence permits nothing outside it, so the figure was the coordinator's or a scope extension's to add.

the gate evidence is written as a nested mapping under tests, a shape a manifest reader returns as the empty string, so the recorded result is invisible to every parse of the manifest even though the file carries it.

the test named "renders exactly as it did" compares two renders both taken at head (bare versus explicit-None), so it cannot see the base it names; the base identity of an ordinary row is pinned only through the empty-clause assertion.

justifications.durability: tests/test_ticker_renders_wait_facts.py fails at base (8 failed, 2 passed over the current ten-test file, the falsifier's own assertion among them per /tmp/review_row/newfile_at_base.log), and its empty-clause assertions fail if the marker leaks into an ordinary row.
justifications.evidence: the cohort reproduced independently here at base 8 failed / 310 passed and head 8 failed / 320 passed with identical failure ids (/tmp/review_row/base_cohort.log, /tmp/review_row/head_cohort.log, and the head ids match the worker's own log), and the falsifier fails at base on its own assertion, but the manifest's tests field is a nested mapping a scalar reader sees as empty.
justifications.fit: UNPROBED_MARKER reuses the module's existing unmeasured-figure glyph with a mechanism comment at reckon/crew/ticker.py:78-86, the predicates follow the module's small-helper idiom, and the naming checks over the added lines find no banned label; the one reservation is that the marker is the same glyph the two spend cells render a few columns to its left, distinguished only by position.
justifications.goal_fidelity: an unprobed wait renders differently from a probed one in every state tested at head (promoted, working, waiting, dispatched all differ from their probed twin, /tmp/review_row/state_probe.py), the marker sits before the clause at reckon/crew/ticker.py:737-742, and the real composer path reproduced it for a status:waiting manifest whose declaration cannot be read as a wait.
justifications.scope_discipline: four of the five changed files are inside the declared four-path fence, and the fifth, docs/figures/rendered-evidence/unprobed-wait-row.svg, is outside it.
